name: Merfolk
description: A group of reef-dwelling merfolk who steal from land-dwellers along the Kapsho Sea.

description_citations.text: "Zurbit". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan boils the merfolk and destroys Palmyra's dam with an earthquake.
timeline.quote: Johan summons an earthquake that destroys the dam, freeing the river road down to Bryce.

citation.text: "Johan (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Through Laquatus's treachery the Otarian merfolk lose most of their empire to the cephalids.
timeline.quote: the merfolk lost much of their Mer Empire to the cephalids due to Laquatus 's treachery

citation.text: "Merfolk", section "Otarian Merfolk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sinkholes let Ravnican merfolk resurface and many join the Simic Combine.
timeline.quote: However, massive sinkholes enabled them to resurface, and many have joined the Simic Combine and risen to leadership positions

citation.text: "Merfolk", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Shandalar merfolk kingdom is conquered by the warlord Talrand.
timeline.quote: the merfolk kingdom was conquered by the warlord Talrand

citation.text: "Merfolk", section "Shandalar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zurbit discovers Relno's tower ransacked by merfolk.
timeline.quote: The bookshelves in Relno 's tower were bare, papers were everywhere, flasks and beakers lay broken

citation.text: "Zurbit", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zurbit rows Pip out to the merfolk reef and tosses a threatening message in a flask overboard.
timeline.quote: hastily scrawled a message, announcing that the merfolk should give back the stolen goods or they would be sorry

citation.text: "Zurbit", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zurbit feeds Pip a potion that makes the cat grow to the size of a small whale over the merfolk reef.
timeline.quote: while Pip slowly grew to the size of a small whale
